entities.name: Tinybones
entities.description: A tiny animated skeleton rogue from Urborg on Dominaria who steals to feed his ersatz family.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Recruited Tinybones for a heist on Maag Taranau.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: Oko's son, whose sight caused Oko's illusion to fail.

entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: Legendary treasure vault at the center of Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane with the vault Maag Taranau.

entities.name: Sterling Company
entities.description: Group whose headquarters Oko and Tinybones raided for a vault key.

entities.name: Akul
entities.description: Assaulted the crew within the vault.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Took a liking to Tinybones and left with him for further adventures.

entities.name: Titanbones
entities.description: Echoverse version of Tinybones who grew massive and became a kindly druid.

events.summary: Oko recruits Tinybones for a heist on Maag Taranau; Tinybones travels to Thunder Junction through an Omenpath.
events.quote: Tinybones traveled through an Omenpath to the plane and joined the crew.

events.summary: Tinybones and Oko raid the Sterling Company headquarters and obtain a vault key, but Oko's illusion fails at the sight of Kellan.
events.quote: The plan succeeded in obtaining the key

events.summary: Oko wears Tinybones as bone armor to be captured on purpose; Tinybones undoes his chains and they make a break for Maag Taranau.
events.quote: Tinybones undid his chains, and along with Oko made a break for Maag Taranau.

events.summary: Tinybones helps navigate the vault's traps and escapes after Akul assaults them.
events.quote: Tinybones helped navigate the maze of traps within the vault of Maag Taranau

events.summary: Tinybones departs for further adventures with Rakdos.
events.quote: Tinybones departed for further adventures with Rakdos

relations.quote: He assisted Oko in a raid on the headquarters of the Sterling Company

relations.note: took a liking to the mischievous skeleton
relations.quote: who had taken a liking to the mischievous skeleton
the sight of Oko's son Kellan
